selection:
Bounded resume of the existing calendar-based EIDA queue, without catalogs.

Complete the last three study days first (also useful for downstream waveform
review), then alternate years and months. This is incomplete calendar sampling,
not a completeness experiment. No attempted request is retried.

summary.request_hours: 6-hour full-period queue plus 0.5-hour calendar coverage checks
summary.priority: short requests first, then chronological; no event catalog
summary.accounting: Union of clipped, successfully read sample intervals. Availability metadata and failed requests do not count as coverage.
